title: Untitled (Collage with Targets) 1
description: Dense mixed-media collage incorporating multiple target rings, compact discs, American footballs, printed text fragments, and a small inset photograph of a red automobile. Handwritten names appear in the lower left corner alongside layered paper ephemera, yellow cardboard framing, and ink markings across a white ground.
composition: dense layered fragments across white ground
keywords: mixed-media collage with football and targets
